pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation of wheat straw using a paper chopper to reduce size to 5–10 cm and further crushing with a hammer mill (Fe130, Staida Co., Tianjin) to a mesh size of 5-10 mm.
Chemical pretreatment using potassium hydroxide (KOH) at concentrations of 2%, 4%, and 6% (w/w), with a ratio of WS:KOH:H2O as 1:0.02–0.06:6 (w/w), processed for 36 hours.
Ultrasonic pretreatment using an ultrasonic bath (KH5200DE, Nanjing Xiao Equipment Company, China) operated at a constant intensity of 20 kHz and ambient temperature of (22 ± 1) °C for 36 hours.
